archetypes.name: dyn-tier-waterfall
archetypes.rationale: The new selector encodes subtle attempted, unavailable, and exhausted state distinctions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed tier-selection helper and tests for incorrect state classification. Focus on whether attempted membership, launch-time binary availability, configured ordering, and exhaustion remain mutually consistent for every waterfall order. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
